title: Viva Glint: Rewrite with Copilot for survey comments
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports its admin-opt-in default, licensing and feature behaviour, and the rollout facts match the roadmap. The PowerShell page updated on 23 November still does not publish this setting's featureId. One minor correction remains: the rollout checklist directs administrators to configure a control that has no matching table row.
